options.summary: Caps the number of offsets read per trigger interval; absent it, a catch-up burst pulls an unbounded micro-batch.
When true (default), a query fails rather than silently skipping data when offsets are out of range (e.g. after retention expiry).
Spark SS ignores group.id for offset commits (it tracks its own) but it matters for consumer-group lag monitoring.
earliest/latest/json per-partition offsets; earliest replays retained history on first start.
Consumer-side offset auto-commit advances offsets before processing completes - an at-most-once risk on failure.

security.summary: MSK client_broker PLAINTEXT leaves broker traffic unencrypted; use TLS or TLS_PLAINTEXT during migration.
MSK IAM authentication (SASL AWS_MSK_IAM) uses IAM principals; the alternative is SCRAM secrets or mutual TLS.
